contract.role: generalized causal-closure correction and exact no-fake-join WIKI-PDA event model

defect.arm_alphabet: Closure v1 rejects WIKI-PDA's C, T, and N arms even though the source IR requires them.
defect.join_shape: Closure v1 requires every mechanism to declare a fork/rejoin and forbidden copy pair. WIKI-PDA is a single persistent causal scanner; inventing a byte-64-style rejoin would change the algorithm.
defect.truth_boundary: A shadow opportunity scorer can receive current truth as a score-only function argument even when every target expression is intended to be causal. A closure that labels this native predecode evidence would overstate what the source proves.
defect.consequence: The v1 format cannot compile WIKI-PDA honestly and cannot distinguish logical source independence from a physical native coder boundary.

closure_v2.source_binding: Bind the Mechanism IR by project-relative path, exact byte count, and SHA-256 rather than a path string alone.
closure_v2.dynamic_arms: Closure arms and every state read/write authority use declared uppercase identities; a future verifier must require exact equality with the source IR arm and role sets.
closure_v2.event_model: Every event has an exact ordinal and one of before_truth, truth_reveal, or after_truth. Every arm access declares sources, state reads/writes, action, and whether truth is forbidden, score-only, or transition-only.
closure_v2.state_model: Named subregions distinguish persistent causal transitions, coordinate-local targets, matched opportunity manifests, arm-private score evidence, and write-only posttruth digests. Controls may write only their own target/evidence regions and cannot feed treatment state.
closure_v2.opportunity_model: Each treatment/control family names its common manifest, treatment, controls, all-targets-frozen event, truth event, and score event.
closure_v2.lifecycle_model: Coordinate and event resets are explicit. Join is nullable; null requires a nonempty reason, while a real join requires retained/discarded state and forbidden copy pairs.
closure_v2.truth_evidence_model: native_predecode requires truth to be physically unavailable during target construction. shadow_score_only_argument requires a bound source artifact, discloses physical truth visibility, and requires independent data-flow plus later native-boundary verification.

wiki_pda_v3_closure.matched_group: D/R/S/N share opportunity_manifest; R/S/N freeze after D selection and before logical truth reveal, then all score on the same coordinate.
wiki_pda_v3_closure.component_priority: C and T are separately observable components; D selects T when active and otherwise C.
wiki_pda_v3_closure.identity_partition: K advances only matched shadow transitions and its private digest. It writes no parent/coder state and emits no prediction.
wiki_pda_v3_closure.control_partition: R/S/N score counters are arm-private and unreadable. Their targets cannot enter D, parser, stack, previous-depth, or transition-table state.
wiki_pda_v3_closure.join: none; coordinate targets reset and completed-event transitions commit in place
wiki_pda_v3_closure.shadow_caveat: The logical truth_reveal event expresses allowed data dependence, not literal C++ argument arrival. The bound scanner has truth visible at ScoreBeforeTruth entry, so this closure alone cannot prove causal execution.

future_verifier_obligations: Reopen and hash the IR, closure schema, closure, and any bound implementation source.
Require unique arm, event, ordinal, source, and state identifiers plus exact IR arm/role and information-source equality.
Require strict contiguous event ordinals, monotone truth phases, one truth reveal, and declared first use no earlier than availability.
Reject undeclared event, source, or state references and any arm access outside the state's declared read/write authority.
Reject current-truth access in a before-truth event and restrict score-only or transition-only truth to compatible posttruth actions.
Require matched controls to read the treatment's common opportunity manifest, freeze before truth, and score at the same score event.
Require arm-private outcome evidence to be unreadable and prove no control score or outcome reaches treatment or persistent prediction state.
For shadow score-only sources, perform independent AST/use-def verification from the truth argument to activation, targets, selectors, and future state; token search is insufficient.
Require native integer-coder integration to materialize probabilities before decoded truth, even after a shadow data-flow pass.
For null join, reject any invented retain/discard behavior; for non-null join, prove complete authoritative retention, ephemeral discard, and forbidden-copy closure.

static_controls.positive_meaning: The WIKI-PDA no-join instance and a schema-only non-null join branch validate.

single_authorized_successor.unchanged_authority: This closure closes one representation dependency only. Compiler, independent verifier, verification/receipt schemas, managed program lock, and execution remain the same sole successor frozen by the control-alphabet contract.
single_authorized_successor.activation: No compiler/verifier source, compilation, scanner run, or canonical manager mutation until qm8 terminalizes and the owned-cleanup managed-lease correction is canonical.

activation_requirements: Qm8 has a terminal independently classified receipt and its process tree, cgroup, scratch owner, lease, and lock are absent.
The separately frozen owned-cleanup managed-lease correction is migrated and independently passing.
A new generalized verification schema and independent verifier implement every cross-reference, causality, shadow-data-flow, outcome-isolation, and conditional-join obligation.
Both independent empty-root compiler builds and every adversarial fixture pass before any generated arm may execute.
Historical v1/v3 schemas, compiler, source, and receipts remain immutable and receive no inferred compatibility.
claim_boundary: This artifact, schema, and closure are static representations only.
The logical event model is not an independent proof that the shadow C++ source is truth-independent.
No compiler, scanner, probability, coder, archive, inverse, package, memory, runtime, Gamma savings, score, or Hutter objective evidence exists.
The live qm8 source, process, cgroup, lease, result, and scratch trees remain untouched.
